lines.say: Hahnah Hahnah no Mee. The Flower-Flower Fruit. Hands that bloom out of thin air.
lines.show: Hana Hana no Mi. The Flower-Flower Fruit. Hands that bloom out of thin air.

lines.say: It's a Paramecia fruit, and it looks a lot like a pink dahlia.
lines.show: It's a Paramecia fruit, and it looks a lot like a pink dahlia.

lines.say: Its user can sprout copies of any body part, from any surface in range. Walls, floors, even an enemy's back.
lines.show: Its user can sprout copies of any body part, from any surface in range. Walls, floors, even an enemy's back.

lines.say: Nico Robin ate it when she was just a child.
lines.show: Nico Robin ate it when she was just a child.

lines.say: When she crosses her arms in an X, the flowers are about to bloom.
lines.show: When she crosses her arms in an X, the flowers are about to bloom.

lines.say: Her signature move? Clutch. Hands sprout on the enemy and bend them backwards.
lines.show: Her signature move? Clutch. Hands sprout on the enemy and bend them backwards.

lines.say: But there's a catch. Hurt one of those sprouted hands, and the pain goes straight to her real body.
lines.show: But there's a catch. Hurt one of those sprouted hands, and the pain goes straight to her real body.

lines.say: And she has to know where she's sprouting. She needs to know where the target is, or what it looks like.
lines.show: And she has to know where she's sprouting. She needs to know where the target is, or what it looks like.

lines.say: Before the timeskip, she could bloom about a hundred arms. After it? A thousand. Meel Flure!
lines.show: Before the timeskip, she could bloom about a hundred arms. After it? A thousand. Mil Fleur!

lines.say: She can even build two giant wings, fifty arms each, and fly for five seconds. See-en Flure, Wing!
lines.show: She can even build two giant wings, fifty arms each, and fly for five seconds. Cien Fleur, Wing!

lines.say: And its range? Oh-dah once joked it's two hundred Hahnah Hahnahs.
lines.show: And its range? Oda once joked it's two hundred Hana Hanas.

lines.say: Which devil fruit should I draw next? Comment below!
lines.show: Which devil fruit should I draw next? Comment below!
